subject: L1 local Research Tower Explorer deferred-governance handoff
why_now: The owner authorized a rapid, bounded local L1 explorer implementation that consumes the locked L0 synthetic witness. Lifecycle reconciliation remains deliberately deferred and separate from this product slice.
key_points: The L0 witness is synthetic-contract evidence with authority_effect none and a claim ceiling that excludes representative, IDE, authority, effect, readiness, promotion, publication, deployment, and release claims.
The L1 product scope is projects/ide-extension, with read-only local consumption of the L0 witness and package snapshot.
The L1 explorer may display static candidate evidence only; mandatory scoped validation remains part of the bounded product work.
This notice records deferred lifecycle reconciliation only. It does not repair, apply, promote, publish, deploy, commit, push, or authorize any work.

open_calls.question: When should the deferred L0 and L1 lifecycle reconciliation be resumed as a separately authorized refresh?

boundaries: Do not select or ingest a real tower in this L1 slice.
Do not add model or provider calls, network access, browser-act capability, or an IDE wrapper.
Do not infer authority, promotion, publication, deployment, release, or readiness from the L0 witness or L1 explorer.
Do not mutate L0 evidence while displaying it; keep consumption local and read-only.
Do not use this notice as authority for product mutation, dispatch, Git publication, or external delivery.

next_actions.action: Implement and validate the bounded local, read-only Research Tower Explorer in projects/ide-extension.
Resume deferred lifecycle reconciliation only through a separately authorized route after the prototype work is complete.
